teaser: From now on every message, secret and handover is signed. The hard part is an agent's first key: two patterns, one built and one proposed.
core_idea: PKI becomes the default for everything we send, and agent identity is solved by choreography rather than cryptography: a session's own ephemeral key confirmed by a person, and, when identity must last, an identity key issued and held centrally after a second-step approval.

figures.caption: How an agent gets its first key: two patterns. A, the agent's own key, confirmed by a person comparing fingerprints, is built at pki.sgit.ai. B, an identity key issued and held centrally after a second-step approval, is proposed.
